description: This file defines a PHP class 'Authorize' within the Opencart framework, extending the base Controller class. It handles sending authorization and reset emails related to customer account authorization, including generating email content, loading models and language resources, and creating tasks to send emails.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending authorization and reset emails for customer accounts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending an authorization email to the customer if the session has a 'code'.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles sending a reset authorization email to the customer based on provided arguments.
